items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Louis Nelson and Joe Oliver. Who else? Richard Jones told me he played at Aberdee's, right? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, Aberdee's.

ctx.x: I don't know. That's where Richard M. Jones and Ernest Rogers and Louis Nelson and Joe Oliver. Who else? Richard Jones told me he played at Aberdee's, right? I don't know.
